text:
marta: heads-up, new canary for harbor-q2 (int8) shows a weird "comma-drop" failure in toolcall NDJSON outputs — parse failures jumped from 0.6% -> 4.9% around 11:05 UTC.
ryan: which sample and run config?
marta: bench-ci ran 3k toolcall slice (slice-2026-03-23-b). config: model=harbor-q2, quant=int8, batch=12, kv_prefix=true, streaming=on.
bench-ci: quick summary:
```
job: bc-1812
samples: 3000
parse_failure_rate: 0.049
failure_mode: missing-comma-between-objects
```
ash: can we see a sanitized example?
marta: pasted example (sanitized):
```
[{"action":"call","name":"read","arguments":{"id":"x1"}}{"action":"call","name":"read","arguments":{"id":"x2"}}]
```
samir: hm looks like two objects concatenated inside an array no comma. suspect kv_prefix replay or token-span drift at chunk boundary. int8 quant tends to lower punctuation logits.
ryan: triage plan: 1) reproduce with kv_prefix=false 2) rerun with batch=1 3) add SDK fallback: ndjson-split-and-insert-comma repair for canary only 4) tag repaired calls with x-ml-repair header.
nash: i'll run (2) and (3) in parallel. samir can run (1) and capture token logits for failing traces.
samir: queued bc-1813: kv_prefix=false limit=1000. also collecting logits for 50 failing samples.
triage-bot: canary alert: parse_failure_rate > 3% 1m 1m hold promotion.
bench-ci: interim bc-1813 results: kv_prefix off -> parse_failure down to 0.011 after 1k. strong signal kv_prefix replay is amplifying missing-comma events.
ash: SDK patch landed to canary: on parse error try inserting commas at '}{' boundaries inside arrays, reparse, mark header x-ml-repair=true.
ryan: run full 3k with repair on + kv_prefix off, compute repaired_success and false_repair against gold.
bench-ci: bc-1814 complete: parse_fail -> 0.010; repaired_success_rate=0.045; false_repair_est=0.0012 (sampled gold). logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-1814/logs
marta: owners: samir -> kv_prefix gating and logits dump; ash -> SDK repair + telemetry; ryan -> dashboard and regression checks; marta -> routing hold + PM comms.
ryan: follow-up: add unit test that stitches streaming chunks with punctuation drop to the canary harness. also check latency/cost impact of disabling kv_prefix for int8.
marta: summary: root cause likely kv_prefix replay + int8 punctuation rank shift causing comma-drop at chunk splice. mitigation: block kv_prefix for int8 until kernel/quant tuning; ship temporary ndjson-insert repair and add telemetry to quantify repairs.
ryan: will monitor metrics for 48h and reopen if >1% parse_fail.
nash: adding failing examples to s3://eng-ml/goldens/harbor-q2/ for model devs.
triage-bot: incident ticket created INC-1812.
marta: thanks team, closing once dashboard stable.
